key_insight: This survey maps deep learning methods for multi-label image classification into six major groups and shows how they improve multi-label recognition across diverse vision tasks.
clinical_relevance: For medical imaging, these advances support more robust detection of multiple findings in a single image, which is relevant to disease screening and decision support.
method: Reviews background: problem definition, datasets, backbones, and evaluation metrics
Organizes methods into six categories: region-, label-, architecture-, representation-, learning-, and data-oriented
Synthesizes challenges, learning dynamics, and future research directions
evidence_signal: The paper is a survey rather than a new experimental study, and it summarizes performance and evaluation practices across existing deep learning-based MLIC literature.
watch_item: Survey conclusions depend on the quality and comparability of the underlying studies, so real-world medical deployment still needs task-specific validation and careful metric selection.
paper_title: Rethinking Multi-Label Image Classification With Deep Learning: Taxonomy, Challenge, and Outlook
